analysis_type: Exact Cholesky whitening of the frozen covariance ellipsoid, complete whitened-box grids and affine native interval arithmetic with explicit outside-ball and unresolved-denominator classification; no exact-global-optimum, guaranteed tightening or fold-5 finite-bound claim

receipt_gate.stage56: Require status=passed and summarySha256 to match the frozen ratio-denominator result
receipt_gate.fold_order: Require identical fold ids and available x positions in native and stage-56 records
receipt_gate.mismatch_policy: Stop before whitening or creating cells if a source hash, receipt, fold order or x inventory differs

whitening_rule.symmetric_quadratic: Use C_s=(C+C^T)/2 for the actual quadratic form, preserving the stored matrix and the stage-56 treatment of its tiny triangular storage asymmetry
whitening_rule.cholesky: Compute a high-precision Cholesky factor of C_s and verify L*L^T against C_s within the frozen numerical tolerance
whitening_rule.cover_proof: The whitened ellipsoid is exactly the radius-r Euclidean ball, which is contained in the cube [-r,r]^4. Every frozen grid partitions this complete cube
whitening_rule.outside_rule: Discard a cell only when its minimum Euclidean distance to the whitened origin is strictly greater than r
whitening_rule.outside_distance: For each coordinate interval, use zero when it contains zero and otherwise the smaller absolute endpoint; sum the squared distances and compare with r^2
whitening_rule.outside_count_reason: For the frozen 1,2,4 grids, the maximum cell-wise minimum norm is at most r, so no cell can be discarded by the strict outside test
whitening_rule.crossing_rule: If a cell may intersect the ball and its denominator interval contains zero, preserve it as unresolved and make the grid union unbounded; never drop it or assign a finite native interval
whitening_rule.union_representation: Represent an unbounded union by union_bounded=false and null numerical endpoints. An unbounded union still covers all finite candidate predictions but is not a finite certificate; its intersection with stage 56 remains the stage-56 interval
whitening_rule.fixed_sign_cells: A cell with a strictly negative or strictly positive denominator interval may be evaluated by reciprocal and arctangent interval arithmetic. A zero-containing interval must not be evaluated as a finite reciprocal interval

known_answer.ratio_witness: delta3=0.6,delta4=-0.8 has whitened norm one and must reconstruct to the same native point
known_answer.outside_cell: All four coordinates are in [0.75,1.25], so minimum norm 1.5>1 and the cell is wholly outside the unit ball
known_answer.possible_ball_cell: All four coordinates are in [0.25,0.75], so minimum norm 0.5<1 and the cell cannot be discarded even though parts may be outside
known_answer.crossing_control: A denominator interval [-1,0.5] with possible ball intersection must produce an unresolved cell and an unbounded union, never a finite reciprocal bound

native_interval_rule.affine_transform: For each cell use exact affine forms b1-b2*x=l0+a_L^T*L*u, b3=c3+L_row3*u and d=d0-L_row4*u. This is an exact change of coordinates, not a Taylor approximation
native_interval_rule.form_interval: Evaluate each affine form over the whitened cell by summing the minimum and maximum of every coefficient times the corresponding endpoint
native_interval_rule.native_interval: After the denominator classification, form the linear, reciprocal and increasing-arctangent intervals and subtract the arctangent interval divided by pi from the linear interval
native_interval_rule.accounting: For every grid require partition cells = evaluated cells + outside cells + unresolved cells; native_cell_evaluation_count=5460-unresolved_cell_count because outside_cell_count=0
native_interval_rule.union_bound: If any unresolved cell exists, the grid union is unbounded. Otherwise take the minimum evaluated lower and maximum evaluated upper over all non-outside cells
native_interval_rule.intersection: Intersect every grid union with the stage-56 final intersection. An unbounded union therefore leaves the stage-56 interval unchanged; bounded unions may tighten or remain unchanged
native_interval_rule.nested_property: Require every finer-grid union and intersection to remain conservative with respect to the preceding coarser grid, allowing an unbounded coarser union
native_interval_rule.no_assumed_tightening: Do not assume whitening or a finer grid tightens any case; retain every unbounded union and unchanged intersection

candidate_rule.source: Reuse the 160 stage-56 full-covariance support candidates and 40 algebraic extremizers without changing their parameters
candidate_rule.transform_witnesses: For every candidate compute u=L^-1*(theta-theta_center), require ||u||<=r within the frozen high-precision tolerance, reconstruct theta_center+L*u and compare with the original parameters
candidate_rule.original_model_evaluations: Evaluate all 200 candidates with the frozen native_model implementation and require negative denominator and finite prediction
candidate_rule.grid_containment: Check each candidate prediction against all three grid unions and intersections, yielding 600 checks. If a union is unbounded, record that containment separately from a finite-interval check
candidate_rule.scope: Candidate transformations and predictions are witnesses only. The cover proof comes from exact whitening and complete cell classification, not from the candidate set

comparison_rule.baseline: The stage-56 final intersection at the same fold and x
comparison_rule.report: For every grid record evaluated, outside and unresolved cells, bounded status, union and intersection widths when finite, width ratio, reduction, tightened and unchanged outcomes
comparison_rule.primary_grid: Grid 4 is frozen for primary reporting before seeing outcomes; all three grids and all failures remain visible
comparison_rule.point_accounting: Retain all 25 observations. The first four folds have 20 available points; fold 5 retains five unavailable points with no cells, candidates or finite residual bounds
comparison_rule.historical_preservation: Do not rewrite stage-56, stage-57 or earlier protocols, summaries, receipts, reports, figures or Word documents

numerical_rule.engine: Use 80-digit mpmath arithmetic for the symmetric covariance, Cholesky factor, forward and inverse transforms, affine forms and native interval arithmetic
numerical_rule.outward_rounding: Apply the frozen 1e-24 relative margin and nextafter conversion to whitened-box endpoints and evaluated native bounds
numerical_rule.transform_tolerance: Require candidate whitened norm not to exceed r beyond 1e-10 relative plus absolute tolerance and reconstruction residuals to remain within 1e-10 relative plus absolute tolerance
numerical_rule.certificate_class: Deterministic conservative cover with high-precision outward-rounded evaluated cells and explicit unresolved cells; not exact rational arithmetic or probability
numerical_rule.empty_intersection: An empty intersection or uncovered center is a construction failure, not a cell or point to delete

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Roszman1协方差白化覆盖_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed centers, covariance matrices, folds, grids, historical results or post-hoc grid selection
No whitening with a nonsymmetric substitute for the actual quadratic form and no hiding of triangular storage asymmetry
No discarding a cell unless its minimum whitened distance proves it wholly outside the ball
No finite reciprocal, arctangent or prediction interval for a zero-containing denominator cell
No hiding unresolved cells, unbounded unions, unchanged intersections or candidate violations
No cells, candidates or finite residual bounds for fold 5
No exact-global-optimum, guaranteed-tightening, probability or independent-experiment claim
No replacement of stage-56 or stage-57 baselines and no candidate-based substitute for the cover proof
